text:
mina: rolled a small hybrid-quant + prefetch advisor tweak to a 7% canary on prod at 08:15 UTC. goal: drop token cost and reduce short-tail latency without model changes.
raj: short bullets please.
mina: changes: 1) enable hybrid int8 path for verified layers on select open models; 2) prefetcher now prioritizes KV for hot prefixes and pre-allocates decode buffers for responses <48 tokens. Both guarded by model-route opt-in.
yara: bench numbers?
mina: ran 75m live-replay + synthetic microburst. For short responses (<48 tokens): p50 6.5ms -> 2.8ms (~57% rel), p95 38ms -> 25ms (~34% rel), p99 220ms -> 180ms (~18% rel). Cost per 1M tokens down ~20% on those routes (quant wins + fewer microbatches).
raj: any change in output quality or repro differences?
mina: ran our regression eval suite: no measurable delta in top-1 text quality on canary samples. A handful of adversarial gen prompts showed minor tokenization edge cases in one experimental model; flagged for model-onboarding team.
bench-bot: perf-run id perf_2026_06_02_0815 - dashboard https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/canary/1777770000 - artifacts uploaded.
ops-bot: current canary nodes: 12 nodes (7% traffic). Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/1777770000.
yara: any odd regressions or tails?
mina: saw a transient embedding latency spike for one route (embed-legacy) early in the run: p95 embeddings 45ms->130ms. Root cause: prefetch buffer competition with embedding worker pool. We throttled prefetcher for embed routes and it resolved. No user-facing incidents.
raj: paste config flags?
mina: pasted snippet: ```json
{
  "quant": {"hybrid_int8_enabled": true, "models_opted": ["open-arc-v1","fast-chat-7b"]},
  "prefetch": {"hot_prefixes": ["/reply","/suggest"], "buffer_alloc_ms": 6, "throttle_for_embeds": true}
}```
yara: rollout plan?
mina: staged: 7% -> 25% (45m) -> 60% (1h) -> 100% with these gates: model-quality regressions >0.5pp OR embedding p95 >2x baseline OR p99 token latency increase >15% triggers rollback. Ops window tonight 23:30 UTC, @raj ok?
raj: ok. add a short canary that runs embedding-heavy traces during the 25% step.
mina: will do. TL;DR: hybrid quant + smarter prefetch -> ~50-60% p50 improvement for short replies and ~20% token cost cut; one transient embed spike fixed via throttle; staged rollout with strict gates. Will drop final notes and artifacts after rollout. :tada:
